en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 4. Muḥammad ibn Ya’qūb narrated to me from a group of our companions including Aḥmad ibn Idrīs and Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from ‘Amraki ibn ‘Ali, from Yaḥyā – who was the servant of Imam Jawād (a.s.), from some of our companions who narrated from Muḥammad ibn ‘Ali ibn Ḥusain (Imam Bāqir (a.s.)), who said:

The Messenger of Allāh (s.a.a.w.) said: On the Day of Judgment, I will go to the Ziyārah of those who have come to my Ziyārah or the Ziyārah of anyone from my progeny and I will save them from the terrors of that day.
